description: This file defines configuration settings for push notifications within an iOS application, including enums for transport and environment modes, and a struct for managing build configuration based on data from the application's Info.plist.

classes.name: PushBuildConfig
classes.description: A struct that encapsulates push notification build configuration, reading its values from the application's bundle and providing methods to interpret URL and enum values.

methods.name: readURL
methods.description: Reads and validates a URL string from the bundle's Info.plist, ensuring it is a proper HTTPS URL without user info or query parameters.

methods.name: readEnum
methods.description: Reads and parses a string value from the bundle's Info.plist into a RawRepresentable enum, with a fallback value.
